title: Constitutive ownership of saturated continuation for prescribed-GWL mode 1

source_semantics.inside_profile_saturated_water_content: legacy HeadCalc sets theta(i)=cofgen(2,i) for i=NN+1:numnod
source_semantics.saturated_continuation_conductivity: legacy HeadCalc lower-interface mean uses cofgen(3,NN+1) as the saturated lower-side conductivity
source_semantics.typed_default_provider: for head>=0, water content is cofgen(2); with KSATEXM disabled, saturated conductivity resolves to cofgen(3)
source_semantics.typed_ksatexm_provider: when opt-in KSATEXM is active and cofgen(10)>cofgen(3), fully saturated conductivity can be cofgen(10), as independently qualified by F-SI39

decisions: LOW01-B first live research slice is restricted to the canonical default constitutive route with KSATEXM disabled.

In that bounded slice, provider-owned saturated theta and K are source-equivalent to legacy cofgen(2) and cofgen(3), so a research adapter can have one explicit constitutive owner without changing mode-1 physics.
KSATEXM-enabled LOW01-B is a separate unresolved semantics question: blindly replacing legacy cofgen(3) continuation by provider saturated K would change the preserved mode-1 source behavior.
Do not call a KSATEXM-enabled mode-1 trial typed/source-equivalent until that choice is independently derived and qualified.
next: Construct an independently testable research-only constitutive bridge for the KSATEXM-disabled LOW01-B slice using the same B110 parameter authority.
Qualify the bridge against the typed provider before any mode-1 HeadCalc trial.
Only then execute LOW01-B inside-profile hydrostatic and mass/replay gates.
